messages:
anika: Quick bring-up notes for Aquila-14b (int8 baseline vs int6 tuned) after a 30h mixed workload run. Posting compact findings and a routing/holdback suggestion.

anika: TL;DR: int6 gives ~21% token-unit savings and better median latency on generator-style calls, but we see a non-trivial regression on multi-hop QA and reranker recall when prompts include multiple similar passages. Summarization and short chat flows look fine.

devon: numbers + sample breakdown?

anika: 20k samples: 9k multi-hop QA, 6k summarization, 5k short-chats / completions. Hosted proxy unit cost: int8=$0.0100/k tok, int6=$0.0079/k tok (~21% savings). p50 latency int8=495ms -> int6=430ms. p95 latency int8=1080ms -> int6=1115ms. Throughput +11% on our Dedicated pool.

pavel: how are rerankers affected? any change in log-prob stability or calibration?

anika: reranker-style eval (n=2k queries with candidate passages) shows MAP drop ~5.1% and pairwise ordering flipped in borderline cases. Also observed higher sensitivity with deterministic decoding (temp=0.0) vs sampling; int6 seems to perturb low-entropy logits under tight beam/argmax.

claire: that's worrying for doc search and GTN rerank flow. Do we have per-slice numbers?

anika: pasted mini-scorecard below (CSV-ish):

metric,int8,int6,delta
unit_cost($/k),0.0100,0.0079,-21%
p50_latency(ms),495,430,-13%
p95_latency(ms),1080,1115,+3.2%
multi-hop_QA_exact(%),69.2,64.0,-5.2pp
reranker_MAP(%),82.4,77.3,-5.1pp
summarization_ROUGE_L,0.68,0.675,-0.7%
throughput(tokens/s),2000,2220,+11%
kv_cache_hit(long),0.61,0.55,-6pp

anika: failure mode: when multiple near-duplicate passages exist, int6 sometimes lowers the correct candidate score and swaps top-1. For multi-hop QA the model drops intermediate supporting span recall.

devon: can we mitigate via decoding/temperature or reranker thresholds?

anika: tried nudging temp and using higher beam width for rerankers; beam helps but increases cost and latency. Reranker fallback to int8 for scoring-topK is an option: generate candidates on int6, score top-K on int8.

pavel: routing idea? holdback plan?

anika: Routing proposal: keep default int8. Allow int6 for generator-only calls where caller indicates feature_hint in SDK: {"mode":"gen","est_out":<300>,"deterministic":false}. Holdback rules: force int8 when feature_hint.mode in ["rerank","doc-qa","multi-hop"] OR prompt contains >=2 passage markers OR examples_count >=2. Soft canary: 8% of eligible gen traffic -> monitor 72h.

claire: Monitoring: need MAP/exact-match by slice, latency p95, unit cost, and candidate flip rate (how often top1 changes). Alert if multi-hop exact drops >2% or reranker_MAP drops >1.5%.

anika: infra note: Dedicated can batch int6 bigger to increase econ gains but beware KV cache eviction. Also suggest enabling a small-inflight shadow scoring: when choosing int6 path, shadow-score top1 with int8 sampling for a small pct (1%) to compute real-time delta.

devon: product: we'll add feature_hint to GTN SDK and conservative defaults. Also add an opt-in toggle for "cost-mode" per customer.

pavel: I'll add snapshot job to capture candidate flips for analysis and store flagged queries in S3.

ci-bot: CI: aquila-int6-smoke passed (4321000300)

anika: Action items summarized: eng-platform: implement routing + shadow scoring hook; observability: canary dashboard + flip-snapshot; product: SDK feature_hint + opt-in; eng-ml: follow-up re-eval after 72h canary. I'll upload the failing examples CSV to the eng-ml drive and share link in thread.

claire: ok, lean conservative for rerank/doc-qa. happy to author the short runbook once canary ticket is up.

anika: filing canary ticket now, ping for review.

ci-bot: Canary ticket created: ML-3107 (aquila-int6-holdback) - 4321000350
